Variants.Content: Panticapaeum and strait ports rely on grain, fish and land-sea exchange. Stores connect hinterland produce to vessels; either blocked shipping or roads hurts civilians and guards.

Panticapaeum depends on grain, fish and land-sea exchange. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Port stores connect hinterland cargo to shipping.

Port stores connect hinterland cargo to shipping. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Panticapaeum depends on grain, fish and land-sea exchange.
